_note: The s.123 deduction: "the whole of the amount paid or deposited in the tax year, being the aggregate of the sums enumerated in Schedule XV, as does not exceed ₹ 150000" (s.123, p.159). Contributors are the Schedule XV clauses, in the Schedule's order (para 1, pp.561–563); clause (a) arrives with W-075a2 (D-134), each policy's premium already limited by para 2 (DED-PREMIUM-SHARE); clauses (c), (j), (k), (l) arrive with W-075a3 (D-154): (c)'s "to the extent of 20 % of salary" is the GOVERNMENT_DEFERRED_ANNUITY sub-cap on GOVERNMENT_SALARY, the Government employments' pay in money under the head, not perquisites (OQ-16, owner); (j), (k), (l) count in full — para 2 reaches para 1(a) alone, the one clause "subject to paragraph 2", and para 1(b) treats (l)'s annuity plan as a deferred annuity contract, which para 2 excludes (OQ-17, owner). EMPLOYEE_NPS is sub-capped first at para 1(y)(i)'s "10% of salary, including dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but excluding all other allowances and perquisites" (p.563) — base SALARY, the employee-pension salary; limb (ii)'s 20% of gross total income for a non-employee is not modelled. What the sub-cap excludes feeds DED-NPS-OWN (s.124(3), (5), (10)). The new regime computes total income without "Chapter VIII other than the provisions of sections 124(1) and 124(2), or 125(2) or 146" (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227), so the old regime only. TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 version below (W-075d1). rulebook DED-80C-001, -ITEMS-001, -NPS-CAP-001. The 1961 counterpart, s.80C, 80CCC, 80CCD(1), 80CCE, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d1). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCE (thc p.340): "The aggregate amount of deductions under section 80C, section 80CCC and sub-section (1) of section 80CCD shall not, in any case, exceed one hundred and fifty thousand rupees" — the same ceiling over the same sums: s.80C(2)(i)–(xxv) (pp.330–333; (xxv) the Central Government employee's additional pension account, F(No.2)A 2019 s.23), s.80CCC (p.338, Schedule XV (x)) and s.80CCD(1) (pp.338–339, Schedule XV (y)), whose "(a) in the case of an employee, ten per cent of his salary" is the EMPLOYEE_NPS sub-cap; 80C(2)(iii)'s "one-fifth of the salary" is the same sub-cap, and (x), (xi), (xii) count as Schedule XV (j), (k), (l) do (D-154). The new regime excludes Chapter VI-A other than s.80CCD(2), s.80CCH(2) and s.80JJAA (s.115BAC(2)(i), FA 2023 s.52(C)). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B4–B9, B20–B23, M1, M14. D-144.
